Describe the listing or pipeline change.

For policy decisions, verify the live numeric repository and owner IDs. Third-party approval must bind the exact issue and submission digest. Transfers, representative authority and sensitive attribution changes need explicit evidence. Never approve by a matching URL or self-declared name alone.

For new listings, moderators must verify:

- Submitter is authorized to represent the developer/team.
- Description, game, category, status and image rights are appropriate.
- Distribution is on GitHub Releases and does not contain a ROM.
- Automated checks pass; changed files are only the intended record, state and images.
- Featured status, if requested, is an editorial decision.

Automated validation does not establish malware safety or inspect archive contents.
